basic_details.job_title: Central Bank of India Counselor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Central Bank of India, Regional Office Bhopal, a public sector bank, is engaging an Incharge/Counselor for a Financial Literacy Centre (FLC) for the post Counselor FLC Bhopal Raisen on contract for one year. Applications in the Annexure-A format go to the Regional Head, Central Bank of India, Regional Office, Bhopal, 9, Arera Hills, Jail Road Bhopal, Pin - 462011, by post or by hand, and must be received by 15 November 2026. The notice is for retired bank officers, ex-servicemen and others who are not bank employees, aged above 45 years and less than 65 years.

content_sections.heading: About Central Bank of India
content_sections.text: Central Bank of India describes itself in the notice as a leading Public Sector Bank with a Pan India branch network of more than 4500 branches, total business of more than 8,12,000.00 crores and a work force of 32000+ employees. This notice comes from its Regional Office, Bhopal, and concerns the engagement of an Incharge/Counselor for FLCs (Financial Literacy Centres) on contract basis for one year.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates have to submit their applications in the given format (Annexure-A). The notice does not give an email address for applications. Address: Regional Head, Central Bank of India, Regional Office, Bhopal, 9, Arera Hills, Jail Road Bhopal, Pin - 462011 Superscription: write "Application for the post of Recruitment as Counselor of FLC on contract" on the application. Application may also be submitted by hand at the same address. The last date for receipt of application is 15.11.2026. No applications shall be entertained beyond the stipulated date, and incomplete applications will be rejected. The postal mode (speed post, registered post or courier) is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post, Counselor FLC, for Bhopal Raisen. Annexure-A refers to the post as Incharge/Counselor for FLCs and has a tick-box for Raisen. Above 45 years of age and less than 65 years, and should possess good health. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and lists no age relaxation. Must be Graduate in any discipline from recognized university. Shall be computer literate, shall be proficient in basic knowledge of MS Office, internet, typing in local language. Retired/VRS opted Bank officials of scale I and above of Nationalized Bank including State Bank of India and RRBs preferred; OR Ex-Serviceman or/and other than Bank Employees (Ex Government School Teacher etc.) having Banking Knowledge and Knowledge of financial services and having completed relevant IIBF certification course. Should have unblemished service record and possess service certificate from the previous employer. Experience as an Officer/permanent employee of 10 years. Should be resident of the same state, preferably same or nearby District. Excellent communication skill in local language is essential. The notice invites retired bank officers, ex-servicemen and/or persons other than bank employees who have experience in working in any Public Sector Banks / SBI (that is, Central Bank of India, any other Public Sector Bank, SBI or RRB). Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post. The "last pay and allowances less pension" condition applies only to a pension co-opted retired bank official of a Nationalized Bank. A non-pensioner is eligible only for Rs. 25,000/- p.m. together with the lump sum of Rs. 1000/- towards Mobile, Conveyance etc. No other benefits or charges shall accrue or be payable. The appointment is on contract basis for a period of one year. Renewal may be possible at the Bank's sole discretion in terms of extant policies and rules. Leave: 15 days per year, with a maximum of 02 days per month.

rows.pay: Amount equivalent to last pay and allowances drawn less the initial pension fixed before commutation plus relief etc. payable thereon, or Rs. 25,000/- p.m., whichever is lower; plus lump sum Rs. 1000/- p.m. towards Mobile, Conveyance etc.

content_sections.heading: Central Bank of India Counselor FLC Bhopal Raisen Job Description
content_sections.text: These officers shall be working as "Counselor-FLCs". They have to oversee the overall functioning of the FLCC.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the Annexure-A format, with a passport size photograph pasted and signed across the photograph. Service certificate from the previous employer; Annexure-A also asks for its date of issue. Name and address of two references, written in the form. Annexure-A has a numbered Enclosures list (1 to 5) to be filled by the applicant; the documents are not named in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for Central Bank of India Counselor FLC Bhopal Raisen applications?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of application is 15.11.2026 (15 November 2026). No applications will be entertained beyond that date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for Counselor FLC in Bhopal Raisen?
faq.answer: The candidate must be a Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university and be computer literate, with basic knowledge of MS Office, internet and typing in the local language.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Central Bank of India FLC Counselor post?
faq.answer: The age should be above 45 years and less than 65 years, and the candidate should possess good health.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the Counselor FLC post?
faq.answer: The contract amount is the last pay and allowances drawn less the initial pension plus relief, or Rs. 25,000/- p.m., whichever is lower. A lump sum of Rs. 1000/- p.m. is paid for mobile, conveyance etc.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for Central Bank of India Counselor FLC?
faq.answer: The notice says "There is no application fee prescribed." Annexure-A nevertheless has a row for details of a non-refundable application fee.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Central Bank of India Counselor FLC post?
faq.answer: Fill the application in the Annexure-A format and write "Application for the post of Recruitment as Counselor of FLC on contract" on it. Send it to the Regional Head, Central Bank of India, Regional Office, Bhopal, 9, Arera Hills, Jail Road Bhopal, Pin - 462011, or submit it by hand at the same address.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for Counselor FLC?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be called for a personal interview, and the decision of the Bank is final.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Counselor FLC post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is on contract basis for one year, and renewal may be possible at the Bank's sole discretion in terms of extant policies and rules.

faq.question: Q9. Who can apply for Counselor FLC at Central Bank of India Bhopal?
faq.answer: The notice invites retired bank officers, ex-servicemen and/or persons other than bank employees who have experience in working in a Public Sector Bank, SBI or RRB. Retired or VRS bank officials of Scale I and above are preferred.

faq.question: Q10. How much leave does the Counselor FLC get?
faq.answer: The Counselor FLC is entitled to 15 days of leave per year, with a maximum of 02 days per month.
